caption: The drawing depicts a wooden door with a rectangular shape and three vertical panels. The door has a dark brown color and a visible wood grain texture. It is set in a pale, textured wall that appears to be made of stone or plaster, with shades of off-white, beige, and faint blue-greys throughout the surrounding area. The floor consists of red-brown tiles arranged in a diagonal pattern, suggesting a terracotta or clay material. Above the door, there is a decorative arch painted directly onto the wall, featuring a combination of geometric and organic motifs in red, orange, and blue colors. The painted design includes zigzag lines, starburst shapes, and a central upward-pointing teardrop shape flanked by curved arrow-like forms, with the entire composition symmetrically positioned above the door. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is handwritten text in black ink that reads "Geoffrey Holt" alongside "Harry Mahn SWAARERI."
title: Restoration Drawing Wall Painting and Door, Facade Mission House
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
